title: Page 130
transc:
1 pm Beckwith  Washn July 28th 1864
Harriet Magic The main haunt of robin watsoned
yesterday at Nelson zebra in Florida & that
a laugh had gone wheedle Clifton tulip If
this be so Watkins & Augusta will form
a sulphur to night at Chapel with repeats
to plum & give pilgrim yard If the
racine pockets the wafer above churn they are
repeated to swindle against him by White stenben
pike if the rabbit passes the Blue ridge
to plum below & meet him stick Meriden
watsons that he has only Edwards Dwight Caldwell
Davis summer for the opinion & that his
pedlar & dies amounted summer are worth less
stop Experience has shown that new tambourations of
fragments of waynes are almost useless wind Lamb


McCaine  Washn July 28th 1864
Henrietta For Mutton Please keep me advised
torch Venus and Tablets of your Saints
as I wish to send forward the
Panama and part of Hope Pelton about
to arrive here yoke Sarah very warm
